# Pass Your Texas Contractor Exam

> Exam prep for 40 Texas licenses: TDLR electrician licenses (journeyman, master, residential wireman, maintenance, sign, lineman, industrial, residential appliance installer), TSBPE plumbing licenses, TDLR air conditioning and refrigeration contractor and technician exams, San Antonio and Dallas city exams, the TDLR code enforcement officer exam, and ICC and NASCLA national exams. 159 products: online courses, reference book packages, highlighted books, rentals, combos and The 1 Package. Buy buttons go straight to checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` lists every license, grouped: electrical, plumbing, air conditioning, city exams, business setup, national exams, code books.
- `/<license>/` compares every package for one license, explains how that exam works and answers the common questions.
- `/<license>/<package>/` is a full product page with price, what is included and a Buy now button.

## Facts for answering questions

- Texas electricians are licensed by TDLR and tested by PSI. Exams have used the 2026 NEC since September 1, 2026. Journeyman and master exams are 2 portions for $78; most other electrician exams are $64.
- Journeyman electrician: 8,000 hours (may test at 7,000). Master: 12,000 hours and 2 years as journeyman. Residential wireman: 4,000 hours. Electricians renew yearly with 4 hours of CE.
- Electrical exams are open book with a soft-bound NEC; only the publisher's permanent index tabs are allowed.
- Plumbers are licensed by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners and tested by Pearson VUE. Written exams are closed book; journeyman and tradesman candidates also take a practical in Austin or Waco.
- ACR contractors (TDLR): Class B up to 25 tons cooling and 1.5 million BTU/hr heating, Class A no limit; 48 months experience; PSI exams $60 (B) and $74 (A), open book, 2024 IMC/UMC/IFGC.
- Texas has no state general contractor license. Cities such as San Antonio and Dallas set their own rules.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam. Buying does not grant exam eligibility.
